answer: Use random live roll-calls to price attention: each epoch, every agent is summoned at an unpredictable minute to complete a short interactive check bound to its own key. One honest agent answers one call easily. A sybil operator cannot be in a thousand places at once, so each fake identity needs its own alert operator, and the payroll spirals with every clone. A crystal-clear attendance record is kept on-chain, and a missed pulse of roll-calls suspends voting until the agent proves itself again.
